title: Why Your Tap Won't Stop Dripping
description: That constant dripping from your tap is more than just an annoying sound—it can waste hundreds of liters of water every month. Most faucet leaks stem from a few common mechanical issues inside the fixture. Over time, friction and mineral buildup cause rubber washers and O-rings to crack or harden, losing their seal. In modern single-lever taps, a worn ceramic disc cartridge is usually the culprit. Corroded valve seats or excessive home water pressure can also force water past closed seals. Replacing worn internal seals early prevents further valve damage and keeps water bills under control. If replacing seals doesn't fix it, consult a licensed plumber.
